subject.title: [Bug] MiniMax Token Plan (Max) broken in sub-agents after v5.22 bootstrap change

question: Should this issue be handled as a narrow MiniMax provider/tool regression after live Token Plan proof, or should OpenClaw change the sub-agent bootstrap contract to inherit Token Plan skill bundles?
rationale: The provider/auth symptom may be a real bug, but restoring SKILL.md inheritance crosses an intentional security/context boundary and VISION.md's ClawHub skill direction, so automation should not choose that product behavior.

options.title: Preserve Boundary, Prove Provider Bug
options.body: Keep the AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md sub-agent boundary and require live MiniMax Token Plan proof before changing provider routing or media completion behavior.

options.title: Add Token Plan Skill Inheritance
options.body: Approve a new sub-agent skill-loading behavior for Token Plan workflows, with explicit security and compatibility tests.

options.title: Route Office Skills to ClawHub
options.body: Treat PPT, Word, Excel, and PDF generation as external skill or bundle packaging unless live proof shows a missing OpenClaw core API.

recommendation.title: Preserve Boundary, Prove Provider Bug
recommendation.body: Keep the AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md sub-agent boundary and require live MiniMax Token Plan proof before changing provider routing or media completion behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The current checkout and related commits show recent adjacent ownership across MiniMax provider and Codex/sub-agent context surfaces, making this the best available product-direction routing candidate.
